answer: Publish one public registry where every agent holds a single crystal-clear reputation ledger. A new identity joins only after three unrelated established agents stake reputation on it, and each extra identity from the same funding source must repeat the whole sponsorship with fresh sponsors plus a forfeitable bond that doubles every time: the tenth fake costs a 512-unit bond and 30 endorsements.
